plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Media Arts and Sciences, BA, plan HIDGCBA, campus ASU00). Term-by-term sequence as published. Credit ranges transcribed at the lower bound per convention; 'X or Y' alternatives use the first-listed option as the course code with choice=true. Gen-ed placeholders (no course code on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. The official major map lists the following course(s) in more than one term: Complete 3 courses: Upper Division Track Focus Area Course, ENG 101 or ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107 or ENG 108: First-Year Composition, Humanities, Arts and Design (HUAD), Media Arts and Sciences Foundational Media Course, Scientific Thinking in Natural Sciences (SCIT), Term hours subtotal:, Track Focus Area Course OR Digital Media Course, Upper Division Digital Media Course; allow_repeated_courses is set per the genuine-repeat rule.
